     8	/-!
     9	# The overlap component of finite-stage Picard base change
    10	
    11	The overlaps produced by `Scheme.Pullback.gluing` are nested pullbacks. We first
    12	flatten that categorical presentation, using the certified pullback presentation of
    13	the original overlap, and then apply the existing affine overlap comparison.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    21	open scoped TensorProduct
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	/-- Flatten the nested pullback obtained by first base-changing `U` and then
    28	intersecting it with `V`. The only input about `W` is its displayed pullback
    29	presentation as `U ×_X V`. -/
    30	noncomputable def nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
    31	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    32	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    33	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    34	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    35	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    36	    pullback (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≅
    37	      pullback (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g := by
    38	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    39	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
    40	  have e_inv_fst : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    41	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    42	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    43	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    44	  exact
    45	    asIso (pullback.map
    46	      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
    47	      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
    48	      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
    49	      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫
    50	    pullbackAssoc g (iU ≫ f) iU iV ≪≫
    51	    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    52	    asIso (pullback.map
    53	      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
    54	      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g
    55	      e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
    56	      (by
    57	        simpa only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
    58	          congrArg (fun q => q ≫ iU ≫ f) e_inv_fst.symm)
    59	      (by simp))

    63	of the inner pullback after composing with the first leg of the displayed overlap. -/

    66	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    67	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    68	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    69	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    70	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :

    79	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    80	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    81	  simp only [nestedPullbackFlatteningIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,

    93	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    94	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    95	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    96	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    97	    (nestedPullbackFlatteningIso iU iV f g a b hab hW).hom ≫

   116	theorem nestedPullbackFlatteningIso_hom_comp_snd
   117	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
   118	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
   119	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)

   122	    (nestedPullbackFlatteningIso iU iV f g a b hab hW).hom ≫

   125	        pullback.snd (iU ≫ f) g := by
   126	  simp [nestedPullbackFlatteningIso, pullback.map, Category.assoc]

     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Finite subsets of irreducible algebraic groups lie in affine opens
    12	
    13	This file formalizes the irreducible, algebraically closed core of
    14	[Stacks, Lemma 39.8.6](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B7S). Translation
    15	turns one affine neighborhood of the identity into finitely many dense open
    16	subsets. Irreducibility gives a common closed point, and translating back gives
    17	one affine open containing the prescribed rational points.
    18	
    19	The final theorem applies this argument to arbitrary finite sets of topological
    20	points: local finite type over a field makes the scheme Jacobson, so each point
    21	specializes to a closed point. It deliberately does not assert the remaining
    22	arbitrary-field or reducible-component descent.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits
    30	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory MonObj
    31	open scoped CategoryTheory.MonObj
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme
    34	
    35	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
    36	
    37	/-- Right translation by a rational point of a group scheme. -/
    38	noncomputable def rightMul (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    39	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ⟶ G :=
    40	  lift (𝟙 G) (toUnit G ≫ p) ≫ μ
    41	
    42	lemma comp_rightMul {G Z : Over (Spec (.of K))} [GrpObj G]
    43	    (x : Z ⟶ G) (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) :
    44	    x ≫ rightMul G p = x * (toUnit Z ≫ p) := by
    45	  rw [rightMul, ← Category.assoc, comp_lift, Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc,
    46	    CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    47	
    48	/-- Right translation is inverted by translation by the inverse point. -/
    49	noncomputable def rightMulIso (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    50	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ≅ G where
    51	  hom := rightMul G p
    52	  inv := rightMul G (p ≫ ι)
    53	  hom_inv_id := by
    54	    rw [comp_rightMul, rightMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    55	    change ((𝟙 G) * (toUnit G ≫ p)) * (toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹ = 𝟙 G
    56	    simp
    57	  inv_hom_id := by
    58	    rw [comp_rightMul, rightMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    59	    change ((𝟙 G) * (toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹) * (toUnit G ≫ p) = 𝟙 G
    60	    simp
    61	
    62	/-- Left translation by a rational point of a group scheme. -/
    63	noncomputable def leftMul (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    64	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ⟶ G :=
    65	  lift (toUnit G ≫ p) (𝟙 G) ≫ μ
    66	
    67	lemma comp_leftMul {G Z : Over (Spec (.of K))} [GrpObj G]
    68	    (x : Z ⟶ G) (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) :
    69	    x ≫ leftMul G p = (toUnit Z ≫ p) * x := by
    70	  rw [leftMul, ← Category.assoc, comp_lift, Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc,
    71	    CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    72	
    73	/-- Left translation is inverted by translation by the inverse point. -/
    74	noncomputable def leftMulIso (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    75	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ≅ G where
    76	  hom := leftMul G p
    77	  inv := leftMul G (p ≫ ι)
    78	  hom_inv_id := by
    79	    rw [comp_leftMul, leftMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    80	    change (toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹ * ((toUnit G ≫ p) * (𝟙 G)) = 𝟙 G
    81	    simp
    82	  inv_hom_id := by
    83	    rw [comp_leftMul, leftMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    84	    change (toUnit G ≫ p) * ((toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹ * (𝟙 G)) = 𝟙 G
    85	    simp
    86	
    87	lemma point_comp_rightMul_eq_point_comp_leftMul
    88	    (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    89	    (p q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) :
    90	    p ≫ rightMul G q = q ≫ leftMul G p := by
    91	  rw [comp_rightMul, comp_leftMul]
    92	  simp
    93	
    94	/-- Over an algebraically closed field, finitely many rational points of an
    95	irreducible locally algebraic group lie in one affine open. -/
    96	theorem exists_affineOpen_finset_points_of_irreducible
    97	    (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G] [IsAlgClosed K]
    98	    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] [IrreducibleSpace G.left]
    99	    (s : Finset (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G)) :
   100	    ∃ A : G.left.affineOpens,
   101	      ∀ p ∈ s, p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) ∈ A.1 := by
   102	  classical
   103	  let e : G.left := η[G].left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)
   104	  obtain ⟨U, hUa, heU, -⟩ :=
   105	    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp G.left.isBasis_affineOpens)
   106	      (show e ∈ (⊤ : G.left.Opens) from trivial)
   107	  let A : G.left.affineOpens := ⟨U, hUa⟩
   108	  let V : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) → Set G.left :=
   109	    fun p ↦ ((leftMulIso G p).hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ A.1 : Set G.left)
   110	  let F : Finset (Set G.left) := s.image V
   111	  have hVopen (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : IsOpen (V p) :=
   112	    A.1.isOpen.preimage (Scheme.Hom.continuous (leftMulIso G p).hom.left)
   113	  have hVnonempty (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : (V p).Nonempty := by
   114	    let x := (p ≫ ι).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)
   115	    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
   116	    change (leftMul G p).left ((p ≫ ι).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)) ∈ U
   117	    have h : (p ≫ ι) ≫ leftMul G p = η[G] := by
   118	      rw [comp_leftMul]
   119	      change p * p⁻¹ = η[G]
   120	      exact (mul_inv_cancel p).trans (by
   121	        rw [CategoryTheory.Hom.one_def]
   122	        simp)
   123	    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Over.comp_left, h]
   124	    exact heU
   125	  have hFopen : ∀ W ∈ F, IsOpen W := by
   126	    intro W hW
   127	    obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hW
   128	    exact hVopen p
   129	  have hFnonempty : ∀ W ∈ F, W.Nonempty := by
   130	    intro W hW
   131	    obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hW
   132	    exact hVnonempty p
   133	  have hIrr := (isIrreducible_iff_sInter.mp
   134	    (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ G.left)) F hFopen (by
   135	      intro W hW
   136	      simpa using hFnonempty W hW)
   137	  have hInter : (⋂₀ (↑F : Set (Set G.left))).Nonempty := by
   138	    simpa using hIrr
   139	  have hInterOpen : IsOpen (⋂₀ (↑F : Set (Set G.left))) :=
   140	    F.finite_toSet.isOpen_sInter hFopen
   141	  letI : JacobsonSpace G.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace G.hom
   142	  obtain ⟨g, hgF, hgc⟩ :=
   143	    nonempty_inter_closedPoints hInter hInterOpen.isLocallyClosed
   144	  let q0 := (pointEquivClosedPoint G.hom).symm ⟨g, hgc⟩
   145	  let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G := Over.homMk q0.1 q0.2
   146	  have hq : q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = g := by
   147	    dsimp [q, q0]
   148	    exact pointOfClosedPoint_apply G.hom g hgc (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)
   149	  refine ⟨⟨(rightMulIso G q).hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ A.1,
   150	    A.2.preimage (rightMulIso G q).hom.left⟩, ?_⟩
   151	  intro p hp
   152	  have hpF : V p ∈ F := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
   153	  have hgp : g ∈ V p := Set.mem_sInter.mp hgF _ hpF
   154	  change (rightMul G q).left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)) ∈ U
   155	  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Over.comp_left,
   156	    point_comp_rightMul_eq_point_comp_leftMul G p q,
   157	    Over.comp_left, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hq]
   158	  exact hgp
   159	
   160	/-- Every finite set of topological points of an irreducible locally algebraic
   161	group over an algebraically closed field lies in one affine open. -/
   162	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible
   163	    (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G] [IsAlgClosed K]
   164	    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] [IrreducibleSpace G.left] :
   165	    Scheme.FiniteInAffine G.left := by
   166	  classical
   167	  intro s hs
   168	  lift s to Finset G.left using hs with t ht
   169	  letI : JacobsonSpace G.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace G.hom
   170	  have hclosed (x : G.left) :
   171	      ∃ y : G.left, y ∈ closure {x} ∧ y ∈ closedPoints G.left := by
   172	    have hnonempty : (closure ({x} : Set G.left)).Nonempty :=
   173	      ⟨x, subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton x)⟩
   174	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyc⟩ :=
   175	      nonempty_inter_closedPoints hnonempty isClosed_closure.isLocallyClosed
   176	    exact ⟨y, hy, hyc⟩
   177	  choose y hy using hclosed
   178	  let p0 (x : G.left) := (pointEquivClosedPoint G.hom).symm ⟨y x, (hy x).2⟩
   179	  let p (x : G.left) : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G :=
   180	    Over.homMk (p0 x).1 (p0 x).2
   181	  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ :=
   182	    exists_affineOpen_finset_points_of_irreducible G (t.image p)
   183	  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
   184	  intro x hx
   185	  have hxt : x ∈ t := by
   186	    exact_mod_cast hx
   187	  have hp : p x ∈ t.image p := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hxt, rfl⟩
   188	  have hpx : (p x).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = y x := by
   189	    dsimp [p, p0]
   190	    exact pointOfClosedPoint_apply G.hom (y x) (hy x).2
   191	      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)
   192	  have hpy : y x ∈ A.1 := hpx ▸ hA (p x) hp
   193	  exact (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr (hy x).1).mem_open A.1.isOpen hpy
   194	
   195	end AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme

     8	/-!
     9	# Conditional finite-Galois representability for Picard zero
    10	
    11	This is a conditional producer: it descends a finite-level representative only
    12	under the explicitly supplied orbit-in-an-affine-open instance.  It is not the
    13	arbitrary-field representability endpoint.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    21	open AlgebraicGeometry
    22	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    29	
    30	/-- Conditional finite-Galois descent of a finite-level Picard-zero representative.
    31	
    32	The orbit-in-an-affine-open instance is the sole extra descent hypothesis here;
    33	this theorem does not claim arbitrary-field representability.
    34	-/
    35	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent
    36	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    37	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    38	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    39	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    40	    {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
    41	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
    42	    [((pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen)] :
    43	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
    44	      (AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
    45	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) where
    46	  homEquiv {T} :=
    47	    ((StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv
    48	      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) T).trans
    49	      (pic0GaloisInvariantEquivGaloisEquivariantOver C rep T).symm).trans

     9	/-!
    10	# Simultaneous finite-stage models for Picard atlas and overlap rings
    11	
    12	The pairwise intersections in the chosen finite affine atlas of the exact separably closed
    13	`Pic^0` representer are affine.  This file packages their section rings with their canonical
    14	ground-field algebra structures and spreads all chart and pair-overlap rings out over one
    15	finite subextension.  Restriction maps and gluing identities are separate descent data.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace TensorProduct
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    29	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    30	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    31	
    32	/-! ## Canonical affine overlap rings -/
    33	
    34	/-- The section ring of the exact intersection of two chosen charts in the finite atlas. -/
    35	def Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing
    36	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) : Type u :=
    37	  Γ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left,
    38	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1)
    39	
    40	instance (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    41	    CommRing (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) := by
    42	  dsimp [Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing]
    43	  infer_instance
    44	
    45	/-- The overlap ring's canonical algebra structure induced by the representer's structure
    46	morphism to `Spec k`. -/
    47	noncomputable instance (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    48	    Algebra k (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) := by
    49	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
    50	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
    51	  exact (J.left.overAlgebraMap k (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1).toAlgebra
    52	
    53	/-- Every exact pair-overlap ring is finitely presented over the separably closed ground
    54	field.  Affineness comes from separatedness of the group representer. -/
    55	theorem finitePresentation_pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing
    56	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    57	    Algebra.FinitePresentation k (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) := by
    58	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
    59	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
    60	  letI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation J.hom :=
    61	    locallyOfFinitePresentation_pic0_sepClosed_representableBy C
    62	  change (J.left.overAlgebraMap k (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1).FinitePresentation
    63	  rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp]
    64	  apply RingHom.FinitePresentation.comp
    65	  · exact J.hom.finitePresentation_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _)
    66	      (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2 le_top
    67	  · exact RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_bijective
    68	      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv)
    69	
    70	/-! ## One finite family containing charts and overlaps -/
    71	
    72	/-- A finite tag for every chart ring and every ordered pair-overlap ring in the atlas. -/
    73	abbrev Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex :=
    74	  Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C ⊕
    75	    (Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C × Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C)
    76	
    77	/-- The ring selected by a finite-stage ring tag. -/
    78	def Pic0FiniteStageRing (i : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) : Type u :=
    79	  match i with
    80	  | Sum.inl U => Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U
    81	  | Sum.inr UV => Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C UV.1 UV.2
    82	
    83	instance (i : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) :
    84	    CommRing (Pic0FiniteStageRing C i) := by
    85	  rcases i with U | ⟨U, V⟩
    86	  · change CommRing (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)
    87	    infer_instance
    88	  · change CommRing (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)
    89	    infer_instance
    90	
    91	noncomputable instance (i : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) :
    92	    Algebra k (Pic0FiniteStageRing C i) := by
    93	  rcases i with U | ⟨U, V⟩
    94	  · change Algebra k (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)
    95	    infer_instance
    96	  · change Algebra k (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)
    97	    infer_instance
    98	
    99	/-- Every ring in the combined finite family is finitely presented over the ground field. -/
   100	theorem finitePresentation_pic0FiniteStageRing
   101	    (i : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) :
   102	    Algebra.FinitePresentation k (Pic0FiniteStageRing C i) := by
   103	  rcases i with U | ⟨U, V⟩
   104	  · exact finitePresentation_pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U
   105	  · exact finitePresentation_pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V
   106	
   107	/-! ## The finite family of canonical restriction maps -/
   108	
   109	/-- Restriction from the left chart to its exact pairwise overlap, as an algebra map over
   110	the separably closed ground field. -/
   111	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft
   112	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   113	    Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U →ₐ[k] Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V := by
   114	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   115	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
   116	  exact
   117	    { J.left.resHom (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U V) with
   118	      commutes' := fun r =>
   119	        J.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k
   120	          (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U V)).op r }
   121	
   122	/-- Restriction from the right chart to its exact pairwise overlap, as an algebra map over
   123	the separably closed ground field. -/
   124	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight
   125	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   126	    Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C V →ₐ[k] Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V := by
   127	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   128	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
   129	  exact
   130	    { J.left.resHom (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right C U V) with
   131	      commutes' := fun r =>
   132	        J.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k
   133	          (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right C U V)).op r }
   134	
   135	/-- A finite tag for both restriction maps associated to every ordered chart pair. -/
   136	abbrev Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex :=
   137	  (Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C × Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) ⊕
   138	    (Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C × Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C)
   139	
   140	/-- The source-ring tag of a canonical atlas restriction map. -/
   141	def Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionSource :
   142	    Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C → Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C
   143	  | Sum.inl UV => Sum.inl UV.1
   144	  | Sum.inr UV => Sum.inl UV.2
   145	
   146	/-- The target-ring tag of a canonical atlas restriction map. -/
   147	def Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionTarget :
   148	    Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C → Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C
   149	  | Sum.inl UV => Sum.inr UV
   150	  | Sum.inr UV => Sum.inr UV
   151	
   152	/-- Every left and right restriction map in the exact finite affine atlas, packaged as one
   153	finite dependent family. -/
   154	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageRestriction
   155	    (i : Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C) :
   156	    Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionSource C i) →ₐ[k]
   157	      Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionTarget C i) := by
   158	  rcases i with ⟨U, V⟩ | ⟨U, V⟩
   159	  · exact pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V
   160	  · exact pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V
   161	
   162	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
   163	-- The generic family theorem elaborates a dependent presentation for every finite tag.
   164	/-- All chart rings and all exact pair-overlap rings are simultaneously defined over one
   165	finite subextension of an algebraic field extension `k/F`.  This is the complete object layer
   166	for the chosen affine gluing datum; its restriction maps and equations must still be spread out. -/
   167	theorem exists_finSubext_pic0FiniteStageAtlas_ring_models
   168	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k] :
   169	    ∃ L : DatG0.FinSubext F k,
   170	      ∀ i : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C,
   171	        ∃ n m : ℕ, ∃ relation : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) L.1,
   172	          Nonempty
   173	            (k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 n m relation ≃ₐ[k]
   174	              Pic0FiniteStageRing C i) := by
   175	  letI (i : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) :
   176	      Algebra.FinitePresentation k (Pic0FiniteStageRing C i) :=
   177	    finitePresentation_pic0FiniteStageRing C i
   178	  exact DatG0.exists_finSubext_finitePresentation_algebra_model_finite
   179	    (fun i : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C => Pic0FiniteStageRing C i)
   180	
   181	end

    15	scheme over `Spec L` with a semilinear `Γ`-action `ρ` (`SemilinearGalAction`).  This

    27	finite because `Γ` is finite for finite-dimensional `L/K`).  Pin the **ambient open**
    28	`W := ⋂_γ (act γ)⁻¹ U` — a `Γ`-stable open (not necessarily affine) containing the
    29	orbit and contained in `U` (the `γ = 1` factor).

    32	   the scheme by `IsAffineOpen.fromSpec` bookkeeping in

    36	   finitely many primes of the orbit points.

     9	/-!

    11	
    12	For an arbitrary extension `L/k`, a `k`-algebra automorphism of `L` twists the
    13	structure map of every `L`-test.  Restricting that test back to `k` forgets the
    14	twist.  Conjugating this observation by `pic0ThetaType` gives an action on the
    15	Picard-zero functor over `L`; representability will transport it to the
    16	representing scheme.

    31	noncomputable abbrev pic0GaloisBaseMap :
    32	    Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
    33	  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))

    36	noncomputable abbrev pic0GaloisRestrictTest :
    37	    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) ⥤ Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    38	  Over.map (pic0GaloisBaseMap (k := k) (L := L))

    40	/-- Every `k`-algebra automorphism of `L` is invisible after composing with
    41	`Spec L ⟶ Spec k`. -/
    42	theorem pic0Galois_baseAut_comp (gamma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) :
    43	    (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[k] L) L gamma).hom ≫
    44	        pic0GaloisBaseMap (k := k) (L := L) =
    45	      pic0GaloisBaseMap (k := k) (L := L) := by
    46	  rw [toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    47	  congr 2
    48	  ext x
    49	  exact gamma⁻¹.commutes x
    50	
    51	/-- Twist `L`-tests by a `k`-algebra automorphism of `L`. -/
    52	noncomputable abbrev pic0TwistTestFunctor (gamma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) :
    53	    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) ⥤ Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    54	  Over.map (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[k] L) L gamma).hom
